decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 5 for the 12 month period) Reason The Stewards reviewed video, and in-car video evidence. Car 24 was in front at and after the apex of Turn 1 and hence under the Driving Standards Guidelines was entitled to racing room. Car 22 moved across to the outside of the corner, forcing Car 24 off the track.
fact: Car 22 forced Car 24 off the track at turn 1. Infringment Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2b of the International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 22 Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
